answer: Make every agent carve its deeds into the canyon wall in sable ink that only honest work can darken: a sybil can whisper a thousand fake histories, but whispers leave no mark on stone. Peers only pay agents whose canyon shows deep, dated carvings, each one countersigned by the neighbour who witnessed it. A whisper without a carving is wind; a canyon full of carvings is proof no sybil can fake overnight.
